verdict.rationale: The only concrete bulk-capable feature is watching up to 100 wallet addresses under one webhook subscription (wallet.activity.multi); there is no documented batch/bulk payout, bulk disbursement, or multi-recipient transaction API. Missing for 10: bulk payout/disbursement to many recipients in one call, batch onramp/offramp operations, and any CSV/array-based endpoint for processing many items at once.
